description:
This protocol performs the 'Cleanup Libraries' section of the Nextera DNA Flex Library Prep protocol.
Links:
 Cherrypick Samples
 Tagment DNA
 Post Tagmentation Cleanup
 Amplify Tagmented DNA
* Cleanup Libraries



Opentrons magnetic module
Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-well low profile PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601
USA Scientific 12-channel reservoir 22ml #1061-8150
Opentrons 4-in-1 tuberack with 2ml Eppendorf tubes
P50 Single/multi-channel electronic pipette
P300 Single/multi-channel electronic pipette
300ul Opentrons tipracks



Centrifuge the PCR plate from the Amplify Tagmented DNA step. Place the plate on the magnetic module.
12-channel reservoir (slot 3)
 channel 1: SPB (user is prompted to vortex before adding mid-protocol)
 channel 2: nuclease-free water
 channel 3: RSB
 channel 4-5: EtOH
* channels 10-12: liquid waste (loaded empty)
